issue: Frozen manual directions are heuristic screen axes used in association, not calibrated ground-truth motion vectors. On front/oblique curves, projected ground motion and apparent head/body orientation need not align.
policy: Angle differences are agreement with a heuristic reference, not direction accuracy. Do not relabel the reference after seeing flow; preserve all vectors. Clear side-view left/right and synthetic mirror consistency can be evaluated separately.
mirror_check: Additional automatic affine0.1s run on horizontally reflected current/past frames and reflected detector boxes. Compare to[-vx,vy]oforiginal, <=15degree tolerance fixed before this run. This measures equivariance, not real-world correctness.
